name: tagpilot-search-console-mcp
description: Free, read-only Google Search Console: search performance, period comparisons, SEO opportunities, URL inspection and sitemaps. No Google Cloud setup.
long_description:
Ask Claude about your Google Search Console data: clicks, impressions, CTR and positions by query, page, country or device; what changed between two periods; low-CTR and "striking distance" opportunities; Google's index status for a URL; and your sitemaps.

**No Google Cloud setup.** Install, ask a Search Console question, and approve in the browser window that opens: sign in to (or create) your free Tag Pilot account, confirm the code, and allow read-only Search Console access. No API key to copy.

**Read-only and private.** The only Google scope is `webmasters.readonly`. Your Search Console data goes from your computer straight to Google; Tag Pilot only brokers the token exchange and stores no Google tokens. The refresh token stays on your computer in `~/.config/tagpilot/search-console-mcp`.

author.name: Tag Pilot (Tag Concierge sp. z o.o.)

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Search Console properties you can read (domain and URL-prefix), with permission level.

tools.name: search_analytics
tools.description: Clicks, impressions, CTR and position by date, query, page, country, device or search appearance.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Period-over-period changes by query or page, with deltas and property totals.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Low-CTR page-one queries and striking-distance (positions ~5–20) queries or pages.

tools.name: inspect_url
tools.description: Google's index status for one URL: coverage, canonical, last crawl, rich results.

tools.name: list_sitemaps
tools.description: Submitted sitemaps with errors, warnings and submitted URL counts.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect this computer: returns a link and code to approve in your browser (free Tag Pilot account + read-only Search Console access).

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Whether this computer is connected, waiting for approval, or needs connecting.

api_key.title: Tag Pilot API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty: your first Search Console question connects this computer to your free Tag Pilot account in the browser. Only for headless setups: a gsc:mcp key (tpk_…) from https://app.tagpilot.io/search-console-mcp
